name: Impeccable Timing lets Chronomancer periodics critically strike natively (#2030)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Impeccable Timing 560949 a single self-targeted APPLY_AURA effect: aura 286 SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT, SpellFamilyName 28, EffectSpellClassMask [0, 319291904, 16777216] (word 1 bits 9, 19, 24, 25, 28). The tooltip reads 'Your periodic damage and healing effects can now critically strike'. The aura type has a real consumer: AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodicData calls AuraEffect::CalcPeriodicCritChance, which returns 0.0 unless the caster's spell-mod owner holds a SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT effect whose IsAffectedOnSpell matches, in which case it returns Player::SpellDoneCritChance. The two fixtures are inside the mask: Timerend 801291 (SpellFamilyName 28, SpellFamilyFlags word 1 bit 24, aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, ATTR2_ALLOW_WHILE_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED so its Stances field does not block the cast) covers the damage half, and Accelerated Recovery 800857 (SpellFamilyName 28, SpellFamilyFlags word 1 bit 28, aura 8 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY so a self-cast is valid) covers the healing half. Both players carry the same spell_crit_rating, so the talent is the only difference between them; the crit chance is snapshotted once at aura creation, which is why each talent is learned before its cast. No script or SQL is needed; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learning the passive applies its aura
The talented Chronomancer's Timerend periodic landed
Without the talent, Timerend's ticks cannot crit
With the talent, Timerend's ticks carry the caster's spell crit chance
The talented Chronomancer's periodic heal landed
Without the talent, Accelerated Recovery's ticks cannot crit
With the talent, Accelerated Recovery's ticks carry a crit chance
